hero.title: Run your academies from one platform, not a pile of disconnected tools
hero.description: Atlas gives education businesses one place to manage academies, courses, students and instructors, publish a branded public website, and see how the business is actually doing — instead of stitching together a spreadsheet, a course tool and a website builder.

whatIsAtlas.title: What Atlas is
whatIsAtlas.description: Atlas is a platform for running an education business: one or more academies, their courses, their students and instructors, and the public website that represents each one — all under a single organization you control. You keep your own branding on every academy's public site; Atlas runs the infrastructure underneath it.

capabilitiesSection.title: Everything an academy needs, already built
capabilitiesSection.description: Each of these is a real, working part of Atlas today — not a roadmap promise.

academies.title: Academy management
academies.description: Create an academy, configure its branding, and manage its members and settings from one dashboard.

lms.title: Courses and learning
lms.description: Build courses out of sections and lessons, add quizzes and assignments, and track completion as students move through them.

students.title: Students, scoped correctly
students.description: A student who signs up through one academy only ever sees that academy — never another academy under the same organization.

instructors.title: Instructors with real boundaries
instructors.description: An instructor only ever teaches the courses assigned to them, with grading and student-progress tools built around exactly that scope.

website.title: A public website for every academy
website.description: Every academy gets its own branded public website — built from the same section-based builder Atlas uses for its own site — with no separate tool to learn.

domains.title: Subdomains and custom domains
domains.description: Every academy is reachable on its own subdomain the moment it's created, with a path to connect a fully custom domain when you're ready.

organizations.title: One organization, many academies
organizations.description: Run a single academy or a whole portfolio of them under one organization, with billing and ownership handled at the organization level.

analytics.title: Analytics that matter
analytics.description: See enrollment, completion and engagement trends across your academies without exporting data into a spreadsheet first.

security.title: Real tenant isolation
security.description: Every academy's data is isolated at the database level, not just hidden in the interface — one customer's data is never reachable by another's.

howItWorks.title: From sign-up to a live academy

organization.title: Create your organization
organization.description: Sign up and create the organization that will own your academies, subscription and billing.

academy.title: Set up your academy
academy.description: Name your academy, add your branding, and it's immediately reachable on its own Atlas subdomain.

launch.title: Launch and grow
launch.description: Add courses, invite instructors, enroll students, and publish your academy's public website.

pricingPreview.title: Straightforward pricing
pricingPreview.description: Start free. Upgrade when your academy needs more room to grow.

finalCta.title: Bring your academy onto Atlas
finalCta.description: Create your organization in minutes — no credit card required to start.
